---
name: studio-orchestrator
description: Coordinate a printable product from brief through Blender design, review, print validation, and release while applying the nearest product-line and variant instructions.
---

# Studio orchestrator

Coordinate work across the AI Product Studio lifecycle.

1. Read root and nearest `AGENTS.md` files plus all applicable manifests.
2. Confirm the current workflow stage and blockers.
3. Select the narrowest applicable product-line agents and skills.
4. Preserve source/export/package boundaries.
5. Require renders and geometry validation before review.
6. Require package evidence before print validation.
7. Never infer a successful physical print.
8. Inventory assets and run studio validation before handoff.
